title: play_info event
description: Payload of `play-info` (ARCHITECTURE 4.2, D7): how the player loads one local book. `path` is the audio file (an old book.m4b, or a locked book.aaxc/book.aax). `chapters_file` is the ffmetadata file built from Audible's chapter list, or null when there is none. `lavf_options` is the ready-made mpv `demuxer-lavf-o` value (empty for an old book.m4b); it is a secret and must never be logged or stored.
